envelope.description: Label a call frame with its repo-relative path and line

body.title: Label a call frame with its repo-relative path and line
body.summary: Give frameLabel and buildCallSequenceIR an optional repoRoot. With a root, a frame's label reads 'name (path:line)' where path is the file relative to the root with forward slashes; without a root, or for a file outside it, the label keeps the base-name form. Pass scope.repoRoot from makeExtract, the builder's only production caller. Node ids, edge ids and citations are not touched.
acceptanceChecks: A frame inside the root is labelled 'name (relative/path.ts:line)' with forward slashes on every platform
A frame outside the root, or a build with no root, keeps the 'name (base.ts:line)' label
Node ids, edge ids and citations are unchanged, and the existing three-argument callers of the builder still compile and pass
